lines.t: We built a life on a maybe You called it marriage in your head
I wore your hoodie like a promise But we never said what should've been said
You played the hero of our story Caught in heaven like you own the sun
Tried to put a crown on my heartbeat Like I already said, yeah, you're the one
You keep swinging verses like a weapon
But you're not God, you're just a man
If you believe what you're professing
Let it bleed out through your hands
So I'm taking back the title
I was never given that shadow
I've been somehow provisioned
If we ever wear those rings
It'll be because it's far more than everything
Till then we sleep like strangers
In the same room, biting my tongue
When I wanna prove that this is love
Let it show up in our steps, not our breath
Cause he said our heart is known by what it does
Next
I'm having love, having panic
Chasing circles in my mind
You feel my anger like static
Every time your truth hits mine
I said you wrecked my perfect picture
Dragged my name through holy ink
But maybe it's me who's been drowning
Why you scared to watch me sing?
He says, daughter, I don't write you off forever
Every soul has got its time
Don't you dare play God endeavor
To let your change be the proof you're mine
So I'm laying down the weapons
Friends, I've been swinging at you
All the guilt trips, all the twisted truth
If we ever wear those rings, it'll be
Cause his hands rebuilt everything
Till then, I'll own the damage that I've done
Let my pride set in the sun
If this is love, let it scream from every move, every step
Cause he said our heart is known by what it does next
I won't twist his letters into chains
Won't tattoo his name on my demands
If he opens up a road, I'll walk it
If he closes this, I'll leave it in his hands
We're bound by kids, not covenant
He called that out, I can't pretend
So I'll stand here in the tension
Let repentance be the message that he sends
No more playing spotless in my own defense
I've been breaking what he meant to mend
I'm laying down the mask, I wanna feel forgiven
No more bedroom faith, no more bloodline living
If we ever wear those rings, it'll be cause this fire welded everything
Till then, light my heart up, burn my lies
Teach these hands to testify
This is love, let it hit and how I move, how I step
Cause he said a heart is known by what it does next
Yeah, I'm done talking like I'm right
Let my life be the song he writes
